provisions.title: Bid Security / Earnest Money Deposit
provisions.summary: Bid security of 2-5% of estimated value may be sought; must be refunded to unsuccessful bidders. MSEs are exempt.

provisions.title: Bidder Qualification Criteria
provisions.summary: Eligibility and qualification criteria (experience, past performance, turnover, capacity) must be stated in bid documents and applied uniformly.

provisions.source: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
provisions.title: Minimum Local Content
provisions.summary: Class-I local suppliers (local content >= 50%) get purchase preference in government procurement.

provisions.source: Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012
provisions.title: MSE Procurement Benefits
provisions.summary: Udyam-registered MSEs get tender-fee/EMD exemption and price preference in government procurement.

provisions.title: Licence to run a Private Security Agency
provisions.summary: No person shall carry on the business of a private security agency without a licence from the state Controlling Authority.

provisions.source: Central Goods and Services Tax Act 2017
provisions.title: GST Registration
provisions.summary: Suppliers above threshold turnover must be registered under GST; registration status must be Active.

provisions.title: Permanent Account Number
provisions.summary: PAN is mandatory for specified persons and transactions; bidder PAN must be valid.

provisions.title: EPF Registration of Establishments
provisions.summary: Establishments employing 20+ persons must register with EPFO; mandatory for manpower contracts.

provisions.source: GeM GTC 4.0 (13 Jan 2023), Clause 3.A.xv read with GFR 2017 Rule 151
provisions.title: Blacklisting / Debarment
provisions.summary: By participating in any GeM bid the seller undertakes it is not debarred from bidding on grounds in GFR 2017 Rule 151; CVC guidelines apply.

provisions.title: Payment of Minimum Wages
provisions.summary: Contractor rates for deployed staff cannot be below government-notified minimum wages for the category.

provisions.title: Accuracy and Integrity of Seller Data
provisions.summary: Complete accuracy and integrity of data submitted by the seller is the seller's sole responsibility; discrepancies invite administrative action.

provisions.title: Performance Security
provisions.summary: Performance security is obtained from the successful bidder, valid 2 months beyond completion of contractual obligations (exemptions below INR 5 lakh).

provisions.title: Integrity Pact
provisions.summary: Bids above the notified threshold require an Integrity Pact as per guidelines on the GeM portal.

provisions.title: Land-Border Country Restrictions
provisions.summary: Bidders from countries sharing a land border with India are eligible only if registered with the competent authority.
